libraries.name: aparté
libraries.note: The chat with Markdown while it streams, its own client for any OpenAI-compatible API, and the agent loop with tools and approvals.

libraries.name: Loquix
libraries.note: Presentational components: the six its Quick Start imports and the token sheet, plus about 50 lines of ours to stream a reply, since it ships no model client; replies are plain text.

variants.label: the full import its README shows

libraries.name: Deep Chat
libraries.note: One element with its own clients for 24 AI services (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama…), Markdown and tool calls; its styles are inside its JavaScript.

variants.label: the CDN script its docs also list, served as it ships

libraries.name: assistant-ui
libraries.note: The AI SDK runtime and the Thread its docs copy into your app: Markdown, tool calls, attachments; the model is called from your server, and its CSS is your Tailwind build’s output.

variants.label: its LocalRuntime with an adapter you write, in place of the AI SDK

libraries.name: CopilotKit
libraries.note: Its documented React chat: Markdown, math, code highlighting, tool calls and generative UI; its runtime runs on a server and is not counted.
